# Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Software Tasks: Time Horizon Doubling Every 7 Months

## Source
- URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14499
- Authors: Thomas Kwa, Ben West, Joel Becker, et al. — Model Evaluation & Threat Research (METR)
- Published: March 2025

## The Time Horizon Metric

The paper proposes a new metric for quantifying AI autonomous capabilities: the **50% task-completion time horizon** — the duration of tasks (measured by how long they take skilled human professionals) that an AI model can complete with 50% success rate. This provides an intuitive, human-grounded measure of real-world AI capability that allows comparison across vastly different models (e.g., GPT-2 vs. Claude 3.7 Sonnet).

The methodology involves three steps: (1) assembling a diverse suite of 170 software/research tasks, (2) timing skilled humans and measuring AI agent success rates on these tasks, and (3) fitting a logistic model to estimate the task duration at which each AI agent achieves 50% success.

![Methodology overview](./assets/figure_2.jpg)

## Task Suite: 170 Tasks from 1 Second to 8 Hours

The benchmark combines three task suites: HCAST (97 diverse software tasks, 1 min–30 hrs), RE-Bench (7 difficult ML research engineering tasks, all 8 hrs), and Software Atomic Actions / SWAA (66 short single-step tasks, 1 sec–30 sec). Over 800 human baselines totaling 2,529 hours were collected.

| Family | Human Time | Description |
|---|---|---|
| find_shell_script | 3 seconds | Multiple choice: "Which file is a shell script?" |
| wikipedia_research | 1 minute | Research simple factual information from Wikipedia |
| oxdna_simple | 9 minutes | Detect and fix a bug in molecular dynamics simulation input files |
| munge_data | 56 minutes | Write a Python script to transform JSON data by inferring conversion rules |
| cuda_backtesting | 8 hours | Implement custom CUDA kernels for 30x speedup of a backtesting tool |

## Exponential Growth in AI Time Horizon (2019–2025)

The central finding is that the 50% time horizon has grown exponentially from 2019 to 2025, with a **doubling time of approximately 207 days (~7 months)** and an R² of 0.97. Key data points across models:

| Model | Release Period | 50% Time Horizon |
|---|---|---|
| GPT-2 | 2019 | ~2 seconds |
| GPT-3 (davinci-002) | 2020 | ~9 seconds |
| GPT-3.5-turbo-instruct | 2023 | ~36 seconds |
| GPT-4 (0314) | 2023 | ~5 minutes |
| GPT-4o | 2024 | ~9 minutes |
| Claude 3 Opus | 2024 | ~6 minutes |
| Claude 3.5 Sonnet (New) | 2024 | ~28 minutes |
| o1 | 2024 | ~39 minutes |
| Claude 3.7 Sonnet | 2025 | ~54 minutes |
| o3 | 2025 | ~1 hour 50 minutes |

![Exponential trend in AI time horizon](./assets/figure_1.jpg)

The 2023–2025 growth rate is approximately 20% faster than the overall 2019–2025 rate, suggesting possible acceleration. The 80% time horizon (tasks completed 80% of the time) shows a similar trend but with horizons roughly 5x shorter.

![Per-model success probability curves](./assets/figure_3.jpg)

## Drivers and Limitations

Progress appears driven by: **improved logical reasoning**, **better tool use**, **greater reliability and self-awareness** in task execution, and **ability to adapt to mistakes**. However, performance is notably lower on less structured, "messier" tasks. External validity remains an open question — the tasks do not perfectly represent the average segment of real-world intellectual labor, though supplementary experiments found little evidence that trends are slower on more realistic tasks.

## Key Findings

- **50% time horizon** provides a robust, intuitive metric for tracking AI autonomous capability growth, with R² = 0.97 over 6 years of model releases.
- Frontier AI agents (o3) can now autonomously complete tasks that take skilled humans **nearly 2 hours**, up from 2 seconds for GPT-2 in 2019.
- The doubling time is **~7 months**, with possible acceleration since 2024.
- Naive extrapolation predicts AI will reach a **1-month time horizon (167 work hours) between mid-2028 and mid-2031**, implying automation of many month-long software projects.
- Key capability drivers are reasoning, tool use, and error recovery; key limitations include poor performance on unstructured tasks and uncertain external validity to real-world job distributions.

python - <<'PY'
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
import json

out_path='/app/output/final_deck.pptx'

prs=Presentation()
prs.slide_width=Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height=Inches(7.5)

# Colors
BG=RGBColor(248,250,252)
TITLE=RGBColor(15,23,42)
TEXT=RGBColor(30,41,59)
ACC=RGBColor(14,116,144)
MUTED=RGBColor(71,85,105)

source='/app/benchmark/source_brief.md'
fig1='/app/benchmark/assets/figure_1.jpg'
fig2='/app/benchmark/assets/figure_2.jpg'
fig3='/app/benchmark/assets/figure_3.jpg'


def set_bg(slide):
    fill=slide.background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb=BG

def add_title(slide, text):
    tb=slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(0.25), Inches(12.2), Inches(0.8))
    tf=tb.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    p=tf.paragraphs[0]
    run=p.add_run()
    run.text=text
    run.font.size=Pt(30)
    run.font.bold=True
    run.font.color.rgb=TITLE


def add_footer(slide, text='Source: METR (2025), arXiv:2503.14499'):
    tb=slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(7.0), Inches(12.0), Inches(0.3))
    tf=tb.text_frame
    p=tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text=text
    p.font.size=Pt(10)
    p.font.color.rgb=MUTED

# Slide 1 Title
s=prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, 'Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Software Tasks: Time Horizon Doubling Every 7 Months')
sub=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(1.5), Inches(11.8), Inches(2.5)).text_frame
p=sub.paragraphs[0]; p.text='Headline finding'; p.font.size=Pt(18); p.font.bold=True; p.font.color.rgb=ACC
p=sub.add_paragraph(); p.text='50% task-completion time horizon has doubled every ~7 months (≈207 days) since 2019.'; p.font.size=Pt(26); p.font.bold=True; p.font.color.rgb=TITLE
p=sub.add_paragraph(); p.text='From GPT-2 (~2 seconds) to o3 (~1 hour 50 minutes) in ~6 years.'; p.font.size=Pt(20); p.font.color.rgb=TEXT
p=sub.add_paragraph(); p.text='Authors: Thomas Kwa, Ben West, Joel Becker, et al. (METR)'; p.font.size=Pt(14); p.font.color.rgb=MUTED
add_footer(s)

# Slide 2 Metric explained + fig2
s=prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s,'A New Metric: 50% Task-Completion Time Horizon')
s.shapes.add_picture(fig2, Inches(7.0), Inches(1.25), width=Inches(5.6), height=Inches(5.1))
box=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.7), Inches(1.3), Inches(6.0), Inches(5.5)).text_frame
steps=[
    '1) Build a diverse suite of 170 software/research tasks.',
    '2) Measure skilled-human completion times and AI success rates on the same tasks.',
    '3) Fit a logistic success model and read off the task duration where success probability = 50%.'
]
box.word_wrap=True
p=box.paragraphs[0]; p.text='Method workflow'; p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(20); p.font.color.rgb=ACC
for st in steps:
    p=box.add_paragraph(); p.text=st; p.level=0; p.font.size=Pt(16); p.font.color.rgb=TEXT
p=box.add_paragraph(); p.text='Interpretation: the “50% horizon” is an intuitive, human-grounded autonomy metric.'; p.font.size=Pt(14); p.font.color.rgb=MUTED
add_footer(s)

# Slide 3 table
s=prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s,'170 Tasks Spanning 3 Seconds to 8 Hours of Human Effort')
rows, cols = 4,4
left,top,width,height=Inches(0.8),Inches(1.4),Inches(11.8),Inches(2.1)
table=s.shapes.add_table(rows,cols,left,top,width,height).table
headers=['Task Suite Source','Task Count','Human-Time Range','Representative Examples']
for i,h in enumerate(headers):
    c=table.cell(0,i); c.text=h
    for p in c.text_frame.paragraphs:
        p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(13); p.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(255,255,255)
    c.fill.solid(); c.fill.fore_color.rgb=ACC

rows_data=[
    ['HCAST','97','~1 min to 30 hrs','wikipedia_research (~1 min), munge_data (~56 min)'],
    ['RE-Bench','7','~8 hrs each','cuda_backtesting (~8 hrs)'],
    ['SWAA','66','~1 sec to 30 sec','find_shell_script (~3 sec)']
]
for r,row in enumerate(rows_data, start=1):
    for cidx,val in enumerate(row):
        cell=table.cell(r,cidx); cell.text=val
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            p.font.size=Pt(12); p.font.color.rgb=TEXT

notes=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8),Inches(3.9),Inches(11.8),Inches(2.8)).text_frame
p=notes.paragraphs[0]; p.text='Suite composition and span'; p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(18); p.font.color.rgb=ACC
for t in [
    'Combined benchmark: 170 tasks with >800 human baselines totaling 2,529 hours.',
    'Example duration span represented in this deck: 3 seconds → 8 hours.',
    'Design intent: mix atomic actions, practical software tasks, and hard research-engineering work.'
]:
    pp=notes.add_paragraph(); pp.text=t; pp.font.size=Pt(15); pp.font.color.rgb=TEXT
add_footer(s)

# Slide 4 fig1 trend
s=prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s,'AI Task Horizon Grew from 2 Seconds (GPT-2) to ~1 Hour 50 Minutes (o3) in 6 Years')
s.shapes.add_picture(fig1, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.2), width=Inches(8.2), height=Inches(5.7))
side=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(9.1),Inches(1.35),Inches(3.9),Inches(5.5)).text_frame
p=side.paragraphs[0]; p.text='Trend fit highlights'; p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(18); p.font.color.rgb=ACC
for t in [
    'Doubling time: ~207 days (~7 months).',
    'Goodness of fit: R² = 0.97.',
    'Milestones: GPT-2 (~2s), GPT-4 0314 (~5m), o3 (~1h50m).',
    'Interpretation: sustained exponential growth in autonomous software-task ability.'
]:
    q=side.add_paragraph(); q.text=t; q.font.size=Pt(14); q.font.color.rgb=TEXT
add_footer(s)

# Slide 5 fig3
s=prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s,'Success Probability Drops Sharply as Task Length Increases for All Models')
s.shapes.add_picture(fig3, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.3), width=Inches(8.4), height=Inches(5.4))
box=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(9.2), Inches(1.4), Inches(3.7), Inches(5.2)).text_frame
p=box.paragraphs[0]; p.text='Per-model curve readout'; p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(18); p.font.color.rgb=ACC
for t in [
    'All models degrade with longer tasks.',
    'Frontier curves are shifted right versus older models.',
    'Approx. 50% horizons: GPT-2 (~2s), Claude 3.7 Sonnet (~54m), o3 (~1h50m).',
    'Gap indicates sizable remaining reliability limits on multi-hour tasks.'
]:
    q=box.add_paragraph(); q.text=t; q.font.size=Pt(14); q.font.color.rgb=TEXT
add_footer(s)

# Slide 6 drivers
s=prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s,'Reasoning, Tool Use, and Error Recovery Drive Time Horizon Growth')
tf=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.9), Inches(1.4), Inches(12.0), Inches(5.8)).text_frame
p=tf.paragraphs[0]; p.text='Observed capability drivers'; p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(20); p.font.color.rgb=ACC
for t in [
    'Improved logical reasoning supports longer dependency chains and planning depth.',
    'Stronger tool use (coding environments, search, debugging) increases execution leverage.',
    'Higher reliability and self-awareness reduce derailment during long trajectories.',
    'Better adaptation to mistakes enables iterative recovery instead of hard failure.'
]:
    q=tf.add_paragraph(); q.text=t; q.font.size=Pt(17); q.font.color.rgb=TEXT
p=tf.add_paragraph(); p.text='Known limitation'; p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(20); p.font.color.rgb=ACC
q=tf.add_paragraph(); q.text='Performance remains materially lower on less structured, “messier” tasks; external validity is still an open question.'; q.font.size=Pt(16); q.font.color.rgb=TEXT
add_footer(s)

# Slide 7 extrapolation
s=prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s,'Extrapolation Predicts Month-Long Task Automation by 2028–2031')
tf=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(1.3), Inches(12.2), Inches(5.9)).text_frame
p=tf.paragraphs[0]; p.text='Forward projection from historical trend'; p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(20); p.font.color.rgb=ACC
for t in [
    'Naive extrapolation implies crossing a 1-month horizon (~167 work hours) between mid-2028 and mid-2031.',
    'Recent period (2023–2025) shows ~20% faster horizon growth than the 2019–2025 fit.',
    'If trend persists, autonomous systems may absorb larger software projects currently requiring multi-week effort.'
]:
    q=tf.add_paragraph(); q.text=t; q.font.size=Pt(17); q.font.color.rgb=TEXT
p=tf.add_paragraph(); p.text='Caveats'; p.font.bold=True; p.font.size=Pt(20); p.font.color.rgb=ACC
for t in [
    'Trend may bend due to model, data, or deployment constraints.',
